additional_info.body:
Good afternoon everyone,
Today i had a meeting with Erik and Michael from Maxem.
We wanted to follow up on implementing EMS into the Siemens Sicharge D charger located at Koopman in Noordhorn the Netherlands. (serialnumber MPR5170001937 )
The challenge right now is that bseveral parties need some information from eachother.
One of the issues is that we need to change the backend url in this charger from E-flux to Maxem.
I beleieve that all of the EMS settings can be done remote.
So therefore i would like to request a meeting with everyone online.
With kind regards,
Steve Spin
Engineer EV charging
+31648201486
steve.spin@kenter.nu
